title: Enhancement: Enable snappi dynamic port selection for T0/T1
author: auspham
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

T0/T1 testbeds should be able to use dynamic port selection introduced by https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/15069


After this we should enable dynamic port selection by default by reverting https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/18793

### Current Behavior

For T0/T1 testbed, the default behaviour is to run without dynamic port selection enabled for snappi tests. This was disable because of https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/18793

### Proposed Behavior

Make sure that dynamic port selection working for T0/T1 testbed and revert https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/18793
